sources.title: T. Hastie, A. Montanari, S. Rosset, and R. J. Tibshirani, Surprises in High-Dimensional Ridgeless Least Squares Interpolation
sources.locator: Full 68-page arXiv PDF retrieved. Inspected §2.1–2.4 (PDF pp. 7–9), §3.2 Theorem 1 (PDF pp. 9–10), and the complete Appendix C.2 proof (PDF pp. 38–39). The source proof uses moments stronger than the finite-fourth-moment local claim and a Rubio–Mestre route; neither is imported.

contents.name: §2.1–2.3: model, conditional risk, min-norm estimator, and bias–variance decomposition
contents.reason: The carrier derives the conditional risk identity directly from the Moore–Penrose projection formulas and states the noise/design conditioning explicitly.

contents.name: §2.4 Proposition 2 and §3.2 Theorem 1: isotropic underparameterized and overparameterized risk formulas
contents.reason: The formulas match the locally proved result. Hastie et al. state finite fourth moment for Proposition 2 and finite 4+eta moment for Theorem 1; the local derivation obtains both branches under the stated finite-fourth assumptions using P-RMT suppliers.

contents.name: Appendix C.2: Theorem 1 proof via Rubio–Mestre and a stronger 8+delta moment assumption
contents.reason: This proof route is not used: it assumes 8+delta moments and invokes the future-dependent Rubio–Mestre leave-one-out argument identified as invalid in the archived source audit. The local cutoff proof is complete and does not rely on that route.
